name: GR-55562
summary: GR-55562 is a selective serotonin 5-HT1B and 5-HT1D receptor antagonist. It is one of several selective serotonin 5-HT1B receptor antagonists used in scientific research.

pharmacology.text: GR-55562 is a selective serotonin 5-HT1B and 5-HT1D receptor antagonist. It is one of several selective serotonin 5-HT1B receptor antagonists used in scientific research. The drug is a silent antagonist of the serotonin 5-HT1B receptor, unlike the related agent GR-127935.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin 5-HT1B and 5-HT1D receptor antagonist; Selective serotonin 5-HT1B antagonist

uses.text: It is one of several selective serotonin 5-HT1B receptor antagonists used in scientific research.

fact.en: The GR at the start of its code name marks it as a compound from Glaxo Group Research, the British drug company's research arm.
fact.zh: 代號開頭的 GR 表示它出自 Glaxo Group Research，也就是這家英國藥廠的研究部門。
